document_purpose: To evaluate a candidate's qualifications, skills, education, and professional experience for potential employment.

fields.reason: Required to unambiguously identify the candidate, manage application tracking, and conduct hiring correspondence.
Date of birth is generally not required for evaluating qualifications during initial employment screening and may create discrimination concerns.
Gender is not required for qualification evaluation, though occasionally collected under optional equal employment opportunity (EEO) demographic monitoring.
Marital status is irrelevant to assessing job competence and creates potential exposure to marital status or gender discrimination.
Religious beliefs are completely irrelevant to job performance and introduce unlawful bias risks under employment regulations.
Government national identification numbers are unnecessary at initial screening and introduce high identity theft exposure.
Required as a primary electronic communication channel for interview scheduling and official employment notifications.
Required for direct contact, telephone screening sessions, and urgent recruitment updates.
Full street address is unnecessary for initial screening (city/region suffices), but may be required for local payroll tax jurisdictions or commute assessment.
Specifies the target role against which candidate qualifications and criteria are evaluated.
